title: myriopteris marsupianthes var. minor
intro: Myriopteris marsupianthes var. minor, commonly known as the "Lesser Rattlesnake Fern," is a type of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is native to the mountainous regions of China and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Myriopteris marsupianthes var. minor include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
